name: Shri Vinayaha
summary: Parsed Labour & Human Rights Policy from 2. Employee welfare and rights policy- SVT.docx.

declaration.preface: As a prominent global supplier and exporter of Indian Home Textile Products, Sri Vinayaha Tex is unwavering in its commitment to upholding the highest standards of employee welfare and rights. Our products are manufactured using ethical and responsible practices. This policy outlines our dedication to fostering a safe, equitable, and inclusive workplace, addressing critical aspects such as employee health and safety, fair compensation and benefits, working conditions, labor relations, career development, prevention of child and forced labor, diversity, equity and inclusion, protection of external stakeholder human rights, and promoting work-life balance.
declaration.declaration: Sri Vinayaha Tex pledges to maintain and enhance the well-being of our employees through rigorous adherence to international labor standards and best practices. We are dedicated to fostering a work environment where every employee is valued, respected, and given the opportunity to thrive. Our baseline year is 2023, which will serve as the reference framework for assessing progress and compliance in our employee rights and welfare practices.
declaration.scope: This Policy is applicable to following sites and all of its employees, workers, sub-contractors and other stakeholders:

focusAreas: prevention of child and forced labor
protection of external stakeholder human rights

employee health and safety: Develop and maintain robust safety protocols and emergency response plans.
fair compensation and benefits: Provide comprehensive benefits packages tailored to employee needs and ensure transparent salary structures
working conditions: Implement regular maintenance and improvement programs for workplace conditions
labor relations: Promote a culture of mutual respect and collaboration between management and staff.
Establish effective channels for employee feedback and grievance resolution.
career development: Offer regular training and development opportunities to support career progression.
prevention of child and forced labor: Enforce strict policies against child and forced labour, ensuring all suppliers adhere to these standards.
diversity, equity and inclusion: Promote a diverse and inclusive workplace where all employees feel respected and valued.
protection of external stakeholder human: Engage with external stakeholders to support and promote human rights initiatives.
promoting work-life balance: Provide flexible working arrangements and support employees in balancing their work and personal lives.

targets.target: Achieve a 100% compliance rate with safety regulations
Conduct quarterly inspections with zero non-compliance issues related to working conditions
Maintain a 95% adherence rate to established workplace safety and comfort standards
Resolve 95% of employee grievances within 30 days of receipt through structured processes.
Ensure that 85% of employees have access to career development programs annually, with at least 75% participating

quantitative.area: prevention of child and forced labor

targets.target: Conduct annual audits of 100% of our supply chain to confirm compliance with child and forced labour regulations
Achieve a 25% increase in diverse representation at all levels of the organization

quantitative.area: protection of external stakeholder human rights

targets.target: Review and address any human rights concerns raised by stakeholders within 60 days of notification.
Achieve a 90% or higher employee satisfaction rating related to work-life balance in annual surveys

responsibilities.duty: Sri Vinayaha Tex will provide annual reports detailing progress towards the above targets. These reports will include qualitative assessments, quantitative data, and an overview of any corrective actions taken. Reports will be made available to all employees and stakeholders to ensure transparency and accountability.
This Employee welfare and rights policy will be reviewed annually by the HR manager to ensure its relevance and effectiveness.

policy.monitoring: Sri Vinayaha Tex will provide annual reports detailing progress towards the above targets. These reports will include qualitative assessments, quantitative data, and an overview of any corrective actions taken. Reports will be made available to all employees and stakeholders to ensure transparency and accountability.
policy.reviewMechanism: This Employee welfare and rights policy will be reviewed annually by the HR manager to ensure its relevance and effectiveness. Feedback from employees, changes in legislation, and advancements in best practices will inform any necessary revisions. The review process will involve consultations with key stakeholders, including employee representatives and external auditors, to ensure comprehensive and ongoing improvement in our employee welfare and rights practices.
